title: Sowing Bountifully, God Loves a Cheerful Giver

questions.question: Now it is superfluous for me to write to you about the ministry for the ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:1 (ESV): "Now it is superfluous for me to write to you about the ministry for the saints,"

questions.question: Paul tells them he had boasted to the Macedonians that Achaia had been ready since ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:2 (ESV): "for I know your readiness, of which I boast about you to the Macedonians, saying that Achaia has been ready since last year. And your zeal has stirred up most of them."

questions.question: Paul is sending the brothers so that his boasting about them might not prove ____ in this matter, so that they may be ready.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:3 (ESV): "But I am sending the brothers so that our boasting about you may not prove empty in this matter, so that you may be ready, as I said you would be;"

questions.question: He thought it necessary to urge the brothers to go on ahead to arrange in advance for the gift they had promised, so that it may be ready as a willing gift, not as an ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:5 (ESV): "So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to go on ahead to you and arrange in advance for the gift you have promised, so that it may be ready as a willing gift, not as an exaction."

questions.question: The point is this: whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows ____ will also reap ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:6 (ESV): "The point is this: whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows bountifully will also reap bountifully."

questions.question: Each one must give as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a ____ giver.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:7 (ESV): "Each one must give as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver."

questions.question: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that having all sufficiency in all things at all times, you may abound in every ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:8 (ESV): "And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that having all sufficiency in all things at all times, you may abound in every good work."

questions.question: Paul quotes Psalms: "He has distributed freely, he has given to the poor; his ____ endures forever."
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:9 (ESV): "As it is written, 'He has distributed freely, he has given to the poor; his righteousness endures forever.'"

questions.question: He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your seed for sowing and increase the ____ of your righteousness.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:10 (ESV): "He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your seed for sowing and increase the harvest of your righteousness."

questions.question: You will be enriched in every way to be generous in every way, which through us will produce ____ to God.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:11 (ESV): "You will be enriched in every way to be generous in every way, which through us will produce thanksgiving to God."

questions.question: For the ministry of this service is not only supplying the needs of the saints but is also overflowing in many thanksgivings to ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:12 (ESV): "For the ministry of this service is not only supplying the needs of the saints but is also overflowing in many thanksgivings to God."

questions.question: By their approval of this service, they will glorify God because of your submission that comes from your confession of the gospel of Christ, and the generosity of your contribution for them and for ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:13 (ESV): "By their approval of this service, they will glorify God because of your submission that comes from your confession of the gospel of Christ, and the generosity of your contribution for them and for all others,"

questions.question: while they long for you and pray for you, because of the surpassing ____ of God upon you.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:14 (ESV): "while they long for you and pray for you, because of the surpassing grace of God upon you."

questions.question: How does Paul end chapter 9, describing God's gift?
options: "Thanks be to God for his inexpressible gift!"
"Praise the Lord for his unspeakable grace!"
"To God be the glory forever and ever!"
questions.correctAnswer: "Thanks be to God for his inexpressible gift!"
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:15 (ESV): "Thanks be to God for his inexpressible gift!"

questions.question: According to verse 7, which two attitudes should NOT accompany a believer's giving?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 9:7 (ESV): "Each one must give as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver."

key_verse_text: The point is this: whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows bountifully will also reap bountifully. Each one must give as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
